decided: The check on reviews fires when the fix-and-recheck loop goes round twice on one problem: a problem the reviewer raised was fixed, a later check found the fix did not hold, it was fixed again, and a second check found that fix did not hold either. It never looks at how many problems a review found or how many reviews were run.
alternatives: fire when a review finds no fewer serious problems than the one before
fire when a review step has used more review rounds than it expected and still has problems open
why: Across the 68 finished changes with reviews, later reviews routinely found more problems than earlier ones and one failed fix was normal, so either count would stop almost every change; the same problem failing twice never happened, so this fires only when the work is genuinely going in circles.
